{`1 Purpose`}

A chat-based assistant that helps individuals manage daily tasks, reminders and schedules in one place.

{`3.1–3.3 Scope: tasks, reminders, scheduling`}

Create and update tasks by chat · reminders by time or place · daily schedule view.

{`3.4 Scope: voice interaction`}

Users can create tasks and reminders by voice and hear their schedule read back.

{`4 Integrations`}

Google Calendar (two-way sync) · Trello (read and create cards).

{`5.1 Risk: calendar conflicts`}

Two-way sync can create duplicate events. Mitigation: match on title and time before writing.

{`5.2 Risk: speech accuracy`}

Voice commands may fail in noisy places. Mitigation: confirm every voice-created task before saving.

HOW I THINK

Four habits that show up in every project.

Four habits I bring to every project. You’ll see each one at work in the case studies above.

Map the real workflow before the interface.

Fix the structure before the surface.

Spend effort where impact is highest.

Let testing change the design.

ABOUT

I like the unglamorous middle of a product: the hand-offs, the exceptions, the screen people keep open all day.

MS in Human-Computer Interaction from Indiana University. Seven years across ProTrans, KGS, The Heart Center, NTT INDYCAR, Indiana University and TCS, designing for operations teams, patients and financial platforms.

{`More about me →`}

WHAT COLLEAGUES SAY

“Karthik is an exceptionally professional and structured UX Designer. Having collaborated with him across multiple UI/UX projects, I was consistently impressed by his problem-solving mindset and ability to bring innovative, alternative perspectives to the table. He is a strong team player who delivers highly constructive feedback, making complex design workflows seamless and efficient. Any team would benefit greatly from his strategic thinking and collaborative approach. It was quite an experience to work on the same team.”
